patches.name: grill-me
patches.local_delta_reason: Keep the explicit core entry thin and delegate the interview to the projected native design-griller, avoiding shared profile switching or in-thread implementation.

patches.name: code-review-and-quality
patches.local_delta_reason: Replace the broader upstream package with a review-only, evidence-first workflow and Codex invocation metadata.

patches.name: grill-with-docs
patches.local_delta_reason: Narrow implicit activation to explicit design grilling and preserve local domain-document and Codex invocation boundaries.

patches.name: grilling
patches.local_delta_reason: Use an explicit, one-question-at-a-time interview for Chinese-first design review; preserve agent-owned fact finding, user-owned decisions, and the no-action confirmation gate.

patches.name: find-skills
patches.local_delta_reason: Preserve read-only discovery while adding a validated Windows npm-cache Node fallback for broken generated npx.cmd shims; installation remains a separate authorization boundary.

patches.name: test-driven-development
patches.local_delta_reason: Narrow activation to explicit strict TDD or a task-level test-first contract, keep verification focused on the declared seam, and remove automatic full-suite, CI, coverage, and file-expansion pressure.

patches.name: systematic-debugging
patches.local_delta_reason: Keep evidence-first root-cause analysis while bounding it to an observed failure, the cheapest discriminating evidence, and the repository's proportional verification ceiling.

patches.name: verification-before-completion
patches.local_delta_reason: Preserve evidence-before-claims while selecting the lowest sufficient gate, reusing exact-current receipts, and preventing verification from expanding scope by itself.

patches.name: research
patches.local_delta_reason: Make research decision-relevant and read-only by default; delegation requires an independent bounded seam and repository persistence requires an explicit user request.
